CabbageNumTrig.description: Many Cabbage get opcodes return a value plus a trigger that fires for one k-cycle whenever that value changes. Cabbage registers two struct types so both outputs can live in a single variable. Use with numeric channels.

CabbageStrTrig.description: Many Cabbage get opcodes return a value plus a trigger that fires for one k-cycle whenever that value changes. Cabbage registers two struct types so both outputs can live in a single variable. Use with string channels and string properties.
